author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
When I was a junior engineer, I used to laughed at the old folks who use Microsoft Words to do code review.

I can't imagine I am using Microsoft Words to do my code review today.   M365 Copilot is the cheapest Opus 4.8 tokens you can find.

Ask the AI agent do dump your code into Word document, then code review with Opus 4.8 using Copilot in Words, then ask AI to merge the changes back to the code base.
